# samber/lo

> samber/lo is a Lodash-style utility library for Go, built on Go 1.18+ generics.
> It provides 449 documented, type-safe helpers for slices, maps, strings, channels,
> tuples and concurrency, with zero dependencies outside the Go standard library.
> 21,000+ GitHub stars, MIT licensed, no breaking changes before v2.0.0.

## Getting started
- [Installation and first steps](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/getting-started): install, import conventions for lo, lop, lom, and lo/it.
- [About and design philosophy](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/about): why lo exists, when to prefer the standard library instead.
- [Glossary](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/glossary): generics, predicates, iteratees, lazy evaluation.

## Core helpers (`lo`)
- [Go Slice Helpers](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/core/slice): 78 helpers — Associate, Chunk, Clone, Compact, Concat.
- [Go Search & Aggregate Helpers](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/core/find): 47 helpers — Earliest, EarliestBy, EarliestByErr, Find, FindDuplicates.
- [Go Map Helpers](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/core/map): 35 helpers — Assign, ChunkEntries, Entries, FilterKeys, FilterKeysErr.
- [Go Set Operations on Slices](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/core/intersect): 21 helpers — Contains, ContainsBy, Difference, ElementsMatch, ElementsMatchBy.
- [Go Pointer & Zero-Value Helpers](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/core/type): 20 helpers — Coalesce, CoalesceMap, CoalesceMapOrEmpty, CoalesceOrEmpty, CoalesceSlice.
- [Go Math Helpers for Collections](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/core/math): 14 helpers — Clamp, Mean, MeanBy, MeanByErr, Mode.
- [Go Tuple Helpers](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/core/tuple): 11 helpers — CrossJoinByErrX, CrossJoinByX, CrossJoinX, TupleX, UnpackX.
- [Go String Helpers](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/core/string): 11 helpers — CamelCase, Capitalize, ChunkString, Ellipsis, KebabCase.
- [Go Concurrency Helpers](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/core/concurrency): 10 helpers — AsyncX, NewDebounce, NewDebounceBy, NewThrottle, NewThrottleBy.
- [Go Error Handling Helpers](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/core/error-handling): 9 helpers — Assert, ErrorsAs, MustX, TryCatch, TryCatchWithErrorValue.
- [Go Channel Helpers](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/core/channel): 9 helpers — Buffer, BufferWithTimeout, ChannelDispatcher, ChannelToSlice, DispatchingStrategy.
- [Ternary Operator in Go](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/core/condition): 3 helpers — If/Else, Switch, Ternary.
- [Go Retry Helpers](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/core/retry): 4 helpers — Attempt, AttemptWhile, AttemptWhileWithDelay, AttemptWithDelay.
- [Go Debounce & Throttle Helpers](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/core/time): 1 helper — DurationX.
- [Go Partial Application Helpers](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/core/function): 1 helper — PartialX.

## Iterator helpers (`lo/it`, Go 1.23+)
- [Go Iterator Slice Helpers (iter.Seq)](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/iter/slice): 9 helpers — Compact, CountValues, CountValuesBy, DropLast, IsSorted.
- [Go Iterator Search Helpers (iter.Seq)](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/iter/find): 38 helpers — CountBy, Earliest, EarliestBy, Find, FindDuplicates.
- [Go Iterator Set Operations (iter.Seq)](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/iter/intersect): 16 helpers — Contains, ContainsBy, ElementsMatch, ElementsMatchBy, Every.
- [Go Iterator Map Helpers (iter.Seq2)](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/iter/map): 15 helpers — Assign, Associate, ChunkEntries, Entries, FilterKeys.
- [Go Channel ↔ Iterator Helpers](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/iter/channel): 3 helpers — ChannelToSeq, SeqToChannel2, SeqToChannel.
- [Go Iterator String Helpers](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/iter/string): 8 helpers — ChunkString, CutPrefix, CutSuffix, Trim, TrimFirst.
- [Go Iterator Sequence Helpers (iter.Seq)](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/iter/sequence): 43 helpers — Buffer, Chunk, Concat, Count, Drain.
- [Go Iterator Math Helpers (iter.Seq)](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/iter/math): 10 helpers — Mean, MeanBy, Mode, Product, ProductBy.
- [Go Iterator Type Helpers](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/iter/type): 10 helpers — CoalesceSeq, CoalesceSeqOrEmpty, Empty, FromAnySeq, FromSeqPtr.
- [Go Iterator Tuple Helpers](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/iter/tuple): 4 helpers — CrossJoinByX, CrossJoinX, ZipByX, ZipX.
- [Go Iterator Condition Helpers](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/iter/condition): 1 helper — IsNotEmpty.

## In-place mutation helpers (`lo/mutable`)
- [In-Place Slice Mutation in Go](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/mutable/slice): 5 helpers — Fill, Filter, Map, Reverse, Shuffle.

## Parallel helpers (`lo/parallel`)
- [Parallel Slice Processing in Go](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/parallel/slice): 5 helpers — ForEach, GroupBy, Map, PartitionBy, Times.

## Experimental helpers (`lo/exp/simd`)
- [Go SIMD Slice Helpers (experimental)](https://lo.samber.dev/docs/experimental/simd): 8 helpers — Clamp, Contains, Max, Mean, MeanBy.

## Comparisons and guides
- [samber/lo vs the Go standard library](https://lo.samber.dev/compare/samber-lo-vs-go-stdlib): what `slices`/`maps` cover, and what lo adds.
- [samber/lo alternatives](https://lo.samber.dev/compare/samber-lo-alternatives): honest comparison with lancet, go-funk, go-linq, pie.
- [samber/lo vs go-funk](https://lo.samber.dev/compare/samber-lo-vs-go-funk): migration guide from reflection to generics.
- [Is samber/lo slow? Verified benchmarks](https://lo.samber.dev/compare/performance): real go test -benchmem allocation data.
- [Is samber/lo production-ready?](https://lo.samber.dev/production-ready): verified adoption, coverage, versioning policy.
- [Lodash to Go](https://lo.samber.dev/guides/from-lodash): function equivalence table for JS/TS developers.
- [lo or ro: choosing the right samber library](https://lo.samber.dev/guides/lo-and-ro): finite in-memory collections (lo) vs infinite event streams (ro).
